source: If you haven't got a weapon, make one. Pick up whatever you can find to defend yourselves.
And watch each other. Any one of us could be the killer.
At this time I'm ordering that all remaining citizens of Elsinore form a group here in the castle's center.
By my order, we are not to leave this place until this horror is contained.
Folks, I know yeh've got questions, but I ain' got answers jus' yet.
Right now, we're mandatin' that all remaining citizens o' Elsinore form a group here in the castle's center.
We en't leavin'. Not until the killer's left outside, if 'e be a stranger, or dead, if 'e be one of our own.
The truth will out.
More mangled bodies have been showing up.
This isn't natural. No human could have done this.
I fear whatever was capable of killing these people far more than I fear any person. No person could've done that.
At this point, I don't trust a single one of you.
Dead. They're all dead. I-is... is such a thing... possible?
I don't know what we ought to do. Remain close, I suspect. That's what Hamlet would say.
Safety in numbers, and so on, and so forth.
I am certain now that all of us shall die.
I fear whatever killed those people far more than I fear any person. For surely, it was no person at all.
What sort of person will I be if I reach the end? If I kill all of them?
You'll find out soon enough. That is, if you're clever enough to hunt down the rest of these little mice.
Mice. That's what they look like to you. Prey.
More or less. What is it Hamlet always says? What a piece of work is man!
How noble in reason, how infinite in faculty!
And yet, to me, what is this quintessence of dust? Man delights not me.
Quince, be honest with me. If I finish this mission you've handed to me, what's going to become of me?
You will have been thoroughly divested of the bonds which connect you to these people and this world.
And then what? To what end?
My sincerest thanks for gathering here, everyone. I'll be brief.
Lady Ophelia, the door's been locked.
I saw what you did. I don't know how you were able to kill like that. But I saw it all the same.
Everyone, Lady Ophelia is in possession of a certain strange power which enables her to kill without touch.
If we value our lives and each other, we cannot allow her to live.
No matter how... much... it pains me to say this.
Uncovered for my acts.

source: I know with absolute certainty. Lady Ophelia did this.
Without so much as laying a hand on her victim's body. It was-- it should have been impossible.
She has to die. I'm ordering her swift and immediate execution, on behalf of all our lives.
Guards, strike her where she stands!
Lady Ophelia killed 'em without even touching 'em. S-she's--there's something wrong wiv' 'er.
She's not human. S-she's some kind of... demon!
S-so, I'm orderin' her immediate execution, fer lack of any other reasonable option.
It's the only thing'll ensure all of th'rest of us survive this 'orrible day.
Guards, to me!
I saw the murder. It was-- it was my sister.
Isn't that right, Ophelia?
It's true. I made Father go away. But only for a little while.
It's true. I made someone go away. But only for a little while.
I can bring them back, Laertes. And I can do it to any of the others, too. Any time I'd like.
There's something wrong with her. She's mad. Or worse.
But this is my blood. I will not allow any harm to come to her.
I'll bind her hands myself, and take her somewhere she can harm no one, even herself.
I love you, sister. No matter what you've become.
I saw someone. Or... something.
That murder. I was there.
Ophelia-- she-- killed someone without even laying her hands on them. I saw her myself.
We have to execute her. Not even throwing her in prison is safe.
Otherwise, all of our lives are in immediate danger. Please, you all have to believe me.
S-she's some kind of monster!
You. Ophelia!
Little devil bitch. Look at me.
You killed Gerta. Some would throw you in prison. Some would exile you.
That won't work on me. Not now. Not like this.
Oh, I know that. But girl, I fear no spirits. And I'm not soft like them.
Thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
If you came from hell, that's where you'll go. I'll put you there myself.
I know who the killer is.
Hamlet died at Ophelia's hand. She's not sane. I'm not even particularly convinced she's still human.
With Hamlet gone, I bear little regard for silence. She's the culprit.
And whatever this is, I'm certain if we don't fight back, it'll cost us our lives.
She's an imminent threat to all of us. Please, heed my warning.
It pains me t' say it, but I saw someone. Lady Ophelia.
She killed 'em without even touching 'em. S-she's--there's something wrong wiv' 'er.
I saw...
Never mind.
Yes, Father?
N... nothing.
Yes, Your Highness?
Ding, dong! Time's up!
Well, the clock's struck midnight. The witching hour is upon us, but you're a poor imitation of a devil!
And you were only beginning to make your moves.
Yet you turned upon your family first and foremost.
You managed quite a bit of progress, didn't you? I find it's easier, after you understand the way their minds work...
These lot are predictable when they're afraid.
Why, you got more than half of them! Such sport! Setting snares right and left.
You were just the faintest little bit away from a perfect victory. And yet! Time is time.
Do remember, the challenge was to ensure that everyone met an early demise.
That includes Claudius, Hamlet, Gertrude, Bernardo, Polonius, Laertes, Marcellus, Irma, Horatio, Rosencrantz, and Guildenstern.
I do congratulate you on the attempt and wish you the best of luck in the next world over.
After all, there's not much point to lingering in this world any more, is there?
They've all gone broken and afraid. No use to anyone now. They'll simply cower until their hearts give out.
I'm returning to the beginning now.
This world's no good to me anymore.

source: No. Your eyes are too cold.
You must be some imposter, some spirit like the one I saw before. Ophelia isn't capable of this.
I've had enough of spirits lately.
Die, then--whoever you are.
N-no. You canna' be her. Ophelia'd never do somethin' like this...
Yer jus' like that vile impersonation of King Hamlet we saw! Some illusion!
Time to go back to hell an' leave us good folk in peace.
My wife told me about this. About what you did. But I didn't believe it.
I don't know what you are-- spirit or demon or otherwise. But no justice could apply to you.
I've no intention of letting you do your vile work on me. Come.
I saw what you did.
What are you? Who are you?
I can't let you leave.
You know, don't you? You know I have to stop you.
I need to see you alone.
Must it be now?
You... and... Father. Are you mad? Did something happen?
What do you intend to do?
I can bring him back, Laertes. And I can do it to any of the others, too. Any time I'd like.
You are not my sister.
No. Something else. Whoever's in there -- whatever you are.
I cannot shake that terrible aim in your gaze.
But you are my blood. I will not allow any harm to come to you.
I promised Mother I would take care of you until the day I died.
But I cannot allow you to go free.
What are you doing? Get off!
Let go of me!
I'll bind your hands myself, and take you somewhere you can harm no one.
Father is dead.
I know what you did.
You... are you mad? Did something happen?
Please. Stop. Please.
Eliminate Laertes?

source: You're right. No more of this.
This ends now.
Oh, my God, Ophelia.
What did you do? Why would you kill someone?
A-and in that kind of way... like... like you weren't human.
Come with me. Let me send you somewhere you won't hurt anyone else.
I love you. I love you so much.
No more of this. Please. No more.
Ophelia. It cannot be true.
What I saw.
What I saw you do.
It isn't real. It can't be. D-death like that... is... impossible!
I didn't mean for you to see it, Father.
So it was real!
Ooh... Elise... I...
He's gone off somewhere.
And making such strange noises, at that.
Claudius. Ophelia-- she's--
What's happened?
She's done something so peculiar.
There's something inside her. Something evil.
I didn't think her capable, but the way she committed such violence...
Whatever you saw, she is still flesh and blood.
I'll bring an end to this.
Bernardo. Did you... see... Ophelia?
When? In what sort of way?
She's... done something horrible.
A-as in, some sort of spirit?
She took a life without laying a hand to anyone!
W-with merely a word!
I see. A trick of the Devil, sent to test us.
There's been far too much of spirits lately.
I'll handle this, my lady.
Marcellus. Did you... see... Ophelia?
Wot happened, Yer Highness?
There's something in her eyes. And her hands are stained with blood.
She took a life with mere words. This cannot be human, can it? This cannot be possible for a woman to do!
M'lady, the devil's been at work aroun' this castle.
This ain't the first apparition this week.
Let me 'andle this, Yer Highness.
Polonius. Have you seen your daughter?
What happened? Is she all right?
No. Something's wrong.
I'm sure there's been a misunderstanding.
No. I know what I saw.
She's possessed by a dark spirit. Or worse.
I must go to her.
Ophelia could never do something like that. I'll set all this right.
T-they're all dead-- all of them--
She's nearby... I...
There's no one left to help me...
I shall perish here. Someone, please! Help me!
Oh, God...
Oh, God, oh, God, oh, God...
Save me. Save me from this.
Everyone's talking about you.
What happened-- was that-- was that real?
It can't be real, can it?
Yes. It's real.
A-and were you-- are you-- are you going to kill us all?
Would you kill me?
I can't promise you anything in this world, Hamlet.
I can't let you continue this.
I won't. Whatever I felt for you-- watching all this-- it's too much.
I have to act.
I'll take whatever punishment comes my way.
After you're dead, that is.
Howl, howl, howl, howl...
She's gone forever.
I know when one is dead and when one lives.
